# NJ-Kit

> NJ-Kit is a free, open-source Claude Code plugin: one working method and 40 skills. Every skill ends in a script gate that says PASS or FAIL. MIT licence, Arabic and English first-class, by Nader Alzghoul.

- [Website](https://nj-burrito.github.io/NJ-Kit/): what is inside, install steps, FAQ
- [Source and skill list](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/NJ-Kit): all 40 skills, README, MIT licence
- Install as a plugin: `/plugin marketplace add NJ-Burrito/NJ-Kit`
- Any agent that reads `SKILL.md` can use the skill folders directly, no installer

## Related

- [Nader Alzghoul, QA Automation Engineer](https://nj-burrito.github.io/): the author
- [Profile-Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Profile-Wrap/): open-source LinkedIn post manager
- [QA-Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/QA-Wrap/): browser extension that turns a test session into a bug report

## Answers

- What is it? A free, open-source Claude Code plugin: one working method and 40 skills, each ending in a PASS or FAIL script gate.
- Install: `/plugin marketplace add NJ-Burrito/NJ-Kit` then `/plugin install nj-kit@nj-kit` (23 skills); the kit installer adds the other 17.
- Other agents: any agent that reads `SKILL.md` can use the skill folders directly.
- Affiliation: independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
- Animated overview: https://nj-burrito.github.io/NJ-Kit/assets/banner.gif
